Discover your potential. Build your legacy.
Go the distance with Capital Group

At Capital Group, we go the distance — for our people, our clients, and each other. As a global, privately held firm with more than 95 years of history, we believe meaningful careers, like meaningful investing, are built over the long term. That’s why we invest in our associates with the same conviction we bring to our clients — through career growth, purpose-driven work, whole-person wellness, and rewards that recognize your contributions. Here, you’ll find the opportunity, global scale and support to unlock your potential and build a career that lasts.

The role 

As an AI Scientist, you’ll develop innovative applications that use large language models and generative AI to address complex challenges in asset management. You’ll build and fine-tune advanced machine learning models, from deep learning and generative architectures to analytical solutions that improve investment insights and client engagement. Working with scientists and engineers, you’ll move ideas from prototype to scalable production applications that support sales and marketing teams and strengthen client outcomes over the long term. 

The team 

You’ll work in a collaborative AI function that brings together scientists and engineers to develop advanced applications for asset management. The team partners with sales and marketing stakeholders to turn investment, client, and engagement needs into practical AI solutions. Together, you’ll combine research, experimentation, and engineering discipline to bring responsible, scalable capabilities into production. 

Your impact 

Prototype conversational assistants that deliver investment insights and help guide client decisions. 
Build and fine-tune large language models and generative AI applications for asset management use cases. 
Develop recommender systems and time series models that support next-best-action predictions. 
Design optimization algorithms that improve targeted client engagement. 
Translate emerging AI research into practical solutions for complex business challenges. 
Collaborate with scientists and engineers to deploy scalable AI applications that support sales and marketing teams and enhance client outcomes. 

What you’ll bring 

A master’s degree in computer science, artificial intelligence, machine learning, or a related technical field. 
One to three years of relevant work or research experience after a master’s degree, or at least one year after a doctorate, developing AI and machine learning applications. 
A strong foundation in machine learning algorithms and deep learning architectures, including neural networks and transformers. 
Proficiency in Python and familiarity with machine learning libraries and frameworks used for model development. 
Hands-on experience with large language models and generative AI techniques, with an interest in advanced concepts such as knowledge graphs, fine-tuning methods, and agentic AI frameworks. 
A commitment to staying current with advances in the field, applying academic research to real-world asset management challenges, and bringing innovative AI solutions into production. 
Clear communication and collaborative skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to varied audiences. 

Preferred 

A doctorate in computer science, artificial intelligence, machine learning, or a related technical field.

What you’ll get
When you go the distance for our clients, we go the distance for you. You’ll grow through mentoring, leadership programs and tuition reimbursement, and do work that matters at a firm managing $3T+ in AUM for millions of investors worldwide. We invest in your whole life too – with comprehensive wellness and mental health support, family-first benefits, competitive pay with performance and profitability bonuses and a company-funded retirement plan. And as a privately held firm built for the long term, we offer the opportunity and support to build a career that lasts.
